objectives_fil: Gamit ang apat na pamantayan, kwentahin at ipaliwanag ang halimbawa ng ranking at sabihin kung bakit hindi nito pinapalitan ang agarang referral.
objectives_en: Using the four criteria, calculate and explain the example ranking and state why it does not replace urgent referral.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang prayoridad ay may malinaw na batayan; hindi nito pinapalitan ang agarang referral.
sections.takeaway_en: Priorities need explicit evidence; they do not replace urgent referral.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ipaliwanag ang marka bago pagkatiwalaan ang kabuuan.
sections.takeaway_en: Explain the scores before trusting the total.

sections.takeaway_fil: Huwag gawing katotohanan ang hula upang makumpleto ang table.
sections.takeaway_en: Do not turn a guess into a fact to complete the table.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang tabla ay dahilan para maglinaw, hindi para gumawa ng dagdag na marka.
sections.takeaway_en: A tie calls for clarification, not invented extra points.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang feedback ay tiyak na pagwawasto, at may bagong pagtatangka.
sections.takeaway_en: Feedback identifies a specific correction and includes a fresh attempt.

sections.takeaway_fil: Malinaw at bukas ang planning decision; hindi nito ipinagpapaliban ang agarang referral.
sections.takeaway_en: A transparent planning decision never postpones urgent referral.

check.prompt_fil: Parehong 17 ang dalawang problema. Alin ang gagawin ng grupo?
check.prompt_en: Two problems both score 17. What should the group do?

options.fil: Balikan ang ebidensya, urgency at resources bago magkasundo.
options.en: Revisit evidence, urgency and resources before agreeing.

options.fil: Unahin ang unang nakasulat para mabilis.
options.en: Choose the first listed to save time.

options.fil: Dagdagan ng isa ang gusto ng lider kahit walang bagong ebidensya.
options.en: Add one point to the leader’s preference without new evidence.

check.feedback_fil: Una: tama—balikan ang ebidensya, urgency at resources at humingi ng dahilan sa bawat kasama. Ikalawa: ang pagiging unang nakalista ay hindi ebidensya. Ikatlo: hindi sapat ang gusto ng lider upang magdagdag ng marka. Sa pagwawasto, pinili ng role-play group ang Plan A bilang panimulang planning step dahil may available na staff time; hindi pa kumpirmado ang transport sa Plan B. Sinabi ng bawat kasama ang dahilan; hindi hinulaan ang pagsang-ayon mula sa katahimikan. Itinala ni Carole ang napagkasunduan at ang transport question na kailangang beripikahin. Kathang-isip ito, hindi totoong schedule o pangako ng partner. Kung may nangangailangan ng agarang pangangalaga, ituloy agad ang referral ayon sa angkop na procedure, kahit nagpapatuloy ang pagpaplano.
check.feedback_en: First: correct—revisit evidence, urgency and resources and ask each partner for reasons. Second: list order is not evidence. Third: the leader’s preference does not justify an extra point. In the corrected ending, the role-play group chooses Plan A as its starting planning step because staff time is available; transport for Plan B remains unconfirmed. Each partner states a reason; agreement is not inferred from silence. Carole records the agreement and the transport question for verification. This is fictional, not a real schedule or partner commitment. If anyone needs urgent care, proceed with referral immediately under the appropriate procedure while planning continues.
